title: One retrieval platform for many business units instead of many proofs of concept
summary: A healthcare organisation's machine-learning lead describes a unified retrieval-augmented knowledge platform giving a reported 300,000-plus employees semantic search across many sources, and names organisational as well as technical hurdles.
